title: CardNetwork settlement file for 2024-08-13 delayed by upstream maintenance
root_cause_detail: CardNetwork ran an unscheduled maintenance window on the evening of 2024-08-13 and has not yet delivered its end-of-day batched settlement file (CN-BATCH-20240813). That file carries the external settlement records for the day's inbound CardNetwork settlement, so the corresponding internal ledger entry cannot auto-match until the file is redelivered and reprocessed. CardNetwork has confirmed the funds are in transit but has not committed a firm redelivery time; the file is expected within the next one to two business days.

contributing_factors.factor: An end-of-day settlement volume peak overlapped the maintenance window.
